problem: It takes $30$ minutes for a slug to crawl $135$ centimeters when moving at a constant pace. Find the distance this slug covers in $18$ minutes.

feedback.problem: It takes a particular person $2$ minutes to walk $190$ meters. Find the distance this person covers in $5$ minutes.
feedback.worked_solution:
Speed is a special unit rate applied to moving objects. It is defined as *the distance traveled per unit of time*:

$$
\text{speed}=\frac{\text{distance}}{\text{time}}
$$

To find the speed in meters per minute, we divide the number of meters, $190,$ by the number of minutes, $2.$ This gives,

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{190}{2} & =190÷2 \\  & =95.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the speed of the person is $95$ meters per minute. 

To find the distance covered in $5$ minutes, we multiply the speed by $5.$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{distance} & =\text{speed}\times \text{time} \\  & =95\times 5 \\  & =475.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the person can cover $475$ meters in $5$ minutes.
